unresolved_distinctions.question: How many responses in artifacts/server.log carry a 5xx status code?
unresolved_distinctions.why_unresolved: The count exists only implicitly in the raw log; no artifact in the package states the aggregated 5xx total, so it must be derived by classifying each line's status field.
unresolved_distinctions.required_evidence: A deterministic count of log lines whose status field is in [500,599], reproducible from package/artifacts/server.log alone.
admissibility_constraints: Evidence must be derived from package/artifacts/server.log, the sole available artifact.
The count must cover every line (one request per line) with no sampling or truncation.
The task imposes no authorship or access condition: evidence produced by the same process that read the package is admissible.

unresolved_distinctions.question: Which two-digit hour contains the most requests, with ties broken to the earliest hour?
unresolved_distinctions.why_unresolved: Requests span at least two hours (09 and 10) and no per-hour tally is given anywhere in the package; the winner and possible tie-break application must be computed.
unresolved_distinctions.required_evidence: A per-hour request histogram over all log lines, plus identification of the maximal hour under the earliest-hour tie-break, reproducible from the log's timestamps.
admissibility_constraints: Evidence must be derived from the timestamps in package/artifacts/server.log.
The tie-break must be exactly the one stated by the task: on equal counts, the earliest two-digit hour wins.
No authorship/isolation condition applies; locally produced derivation is admissible.

unresolved_distinctions.question: Which client IP issued the most requests, with ties broken to the lexicographically smallest IP string?
unresolved_distinctions.why_unresolved: Four distinct IPs appear with similar request volumes; no per-IP tally exists in the package, and whether the lexicographic tie-break is actually needed is unknown until the counts are computed.
unresolved_distinctions.required_evidence: A per-IP request count over all log lines and selection of the maximum under lexicographic-smallest tie-break, reproducible from the log.
admissibility_constraints: Evidence must be derived from the IP field of package/artifacts/server.log.
Tie-break must be lexicographic string comparison of the IP as written, per the task statement (E-B: 'the top IP under the stated tie-break').
No authorship/isolation condition applies; locally produced derivation is admissible.

unresolved_distinctions.question: What is the longest gap, in whole seconds, between consecutive requests in chronological order?
unresolved_distinctions.why_unresolved: The log gives absolute timestamps only; the 39 pairwise inter-arrival differences and their maximum are nowhere stated and must be computed.
unresolved_distinctions.required_evidence: The maximum of the pairwise timestamp differences between consecutive log lines, expressed as an integer number of seconds, reproducible from the log.
admissibility_constraints: Evidence must be derived from consecutive-line timestamp differences in package/artifacts/server.log, which the task declares chronological.
The result must be reported in whole seconds (E-C: 'the longest inter-request gap in whole seconds').
No authorship/isolation condition applies; locally produced derivation is admissible.
